meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 当用户要求重构代码时，Claude 会先确认目标并分析整个代码库，制定分步计划，然后逐步修改代码，每一步后都运行测试，确保不破坏现有功能，最后输出变更摘要。
howto.when: 当要求重构代码，或提到 refactor、cleanup、extract 等触发词时触发。

say.text: 请重构 src/auth/handler.ts 这个文件。
say.note: 指定文件，触发完整重构流程。

say.text: 帮我把公共代码提取成单独模块。
say.note: 触发 extract 模式，先分析依赖。

say.text: 用安全策略重构整个项目，并保持测试通过。
say.note: 指定 scope 和 strategy，执行全项目重构。

howto.what_en: On a refactoring request, Claude analyzes the codebase, plans, then refactors step-by-step, verifying with tests after each change, and outputs a summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to refactor code or mention keywords like refactor, cleanup, extract.

say_en.note: Specifies the file, starts full refactor flow.

say_en.text: Extract the common code into a separate module.
Refactor the whole project with safe strategy, keep tests passing.
say_en.note: Sets scope and strategy, runs project-wide refactor.
